dedupeText: 90s pop brush script album cover brush script 90s pop teal typography close up portrait warm lighting hand drawn lettering teal lettering contrasts against warm skin tones oversized script frames the central face secondary text is contained within a solid rectangular block high angle perspective creates a sense of intimacy combine a warm toned close up portrait with oversized textured brush script in a contrasting cool color like teal and a small boxed secondary text element for a 90s pop aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A 90s-inspired layout featuring oversized, hand-drawn teal brush lettering layered over a warm-toned, close-up portrait.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-angle portrait of a young man with warm, sun-kissed skin tones, framed by large, expressive teal brush-stroke lettering that overlaps the subject at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Teal lettering contrasts against warm skin tones
Oversized script frames the central face
Secondary text is contained within a solid rectangular block
High-angle perspective creates a sense of intimacy
coreInvariants: Warm, golden-hour lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is centrally located, filling the middle third of the frame in a tight close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the large script above and below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large top script down to the eyes, then follows the secondary text block to the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with the subject and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and gold (skin tones and background)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep purple and orange (secondary text block)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the teal lettering against a medium-value, warm-toned photograph.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, expressive brush strokes with visible texture
Inconsistent x-height for a hand-drawn feel
Fluid, connected strokes in some areas, detached in others
Oversized scale relative to the layout
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated loops on ascenders and descenders
Tapered ends on strokes to mimic a physical brush
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, large-scale script paired with a small, rigid geometric sans-serif inside a block.
graphicDevices: Solid rectangular background for secondary text

avoid: Centered secondary text without a box

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-painted, expressive feel of the primary text.
Provides the necessary weight for the secondary text block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up, high-angle portrait of a young man with blonde hair and warm, sun-kissed skin, looking directly at the camera with a slight tilt. The lighting should be golden and warm.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply oversized teal brush-script lettering at the top and bottom of the frame, overlapping the subject. Add a small purple rectangular box in the upper left with bold, orange sans-serif text inside.

verificationChecks: Is the teal text large enough to overlap the subject?
Is the lighting on the subject warm and golden?
Is the secondary text contained within a solid purple box?
Does the script have a visible brush-stroke texture?

adjustableVariables: Placement of the secondary text block
mustRedesign: Avoid using thin or modern serif fonts
Do not use cold or blue-toned lighting for the portrait
Ensure the script is not perfectly clean or geometric

mustAchieve: Dynamic overlapping of text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check for brush texture in the teal lettering
Verify the high-angle perspective of the portrait
Ensure the purple box and orange text are legible
Confirm the teal color is vibrant and saturated
Check that the lettering frames the face without obscuring the eyes
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned close-up portrait with oversized, textured brush script in a contrasting cool color (like teal) and a small, boxed secondary text element for a 90s pop aesthetic.
